names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 10 Δεκεμβρίου, «Όσιος Θωμάς ο Δεφουρκινός», with the rank word left off. The by-name Δεφουρκινός is kept in the slug and the English form and not in the stored Greek form.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 10. децембар ст. ст., „Преподобни Тома Дефуркин.“ — with «Преподобни» left off, that being the `venerable` grade `types` keeps. «Дефуркин» is the by-name this folder’s display name carries, not a rank, and it is what tells him from the other Thomas folders, so §6’s fullest form keeps it. `sr-foldpred.mjs` measured the folded string at 0 other holders.

floruit.note: saint.gr: «Ο Όσιος Θωμάς έζησε τον 9ο μ. Χ. αιώνα». The same page has him answering a letter of the emperor Leo the Wise, whose reign ran 886 to 912 and whom it does not date; the century is the page's own and no year is taken from the reign.

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 10 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. It prints a short modern notice and then a long quotation from the Synaxaristes of Saint Nicodemus the Hagiorite; the life written here follows the short notice, which is the page's own, and does not retell the quotation. The corpus keeps no Thomas on this day. No hymn is printed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 23.12.2025 (10. децембар ст. ст.) — „Преподобни Тома Дефуркин.“

attestations.note: The day’s fourth and last entry, quoted whole with its closing full stop; URL year 2025. `types` UNTOUCHED: «Преподобни» is the `venerable` held, and `monk` and `abbot` came off saint.gr; this book calls him «велики испосник», a great faster, and «победник демона» and «прозорљивац» — no `ascetic` was added, because испосник is the faster and §5 maps подвижник and испосник to `ascetic` as a pair the reader must choose between, and this folder’s `monk` and `abbot` are already the fuller statement of his life. NO `wonderworker`: seeing into things is what «прозорљивац» says and the corpus has no type for it. `dates` UNTOUCHED and it is an AGREEMENT: «Упокојио се у Господу у дубокој старости у IX веку» — he reposed in the Lord in deep old age in the ninth century, which is the `floruit` of 801–900 the folder already carries off saint.gr’s «Ο Όσιος Θωμάς έζησε τον 9ο μ. Χ. αιώνα»; no `death` object was added, because the book states the same century and not a narrower year, and a second interval of identical bounds would say nothing. THE LETTER IS IN BOTH BOOKS AND THIS ONE IS BLUNTER: «Цар Лав Мудри написао му писмо, а он одговори и не отварајући писма царева» — the emperor Leo the Wise wrote him a letter and he answered it WITHOUT OPENING IT. The folder’s date note already records that reign, 886 to 912, and that no year is taken from it. NO `locations`. NO `related` ROW ADDED: `nicodemus-the-hagiorite` is already here, and the emperor is no folder. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.
